name: MeshClient
description: A Meshtastic client for your handheld: read and send messages, browse the mesh, and edit your radio's settings over Bluetooth LE or USB.
author: mcereal

changelog.v2.69.1: Fill the keyboard's tenth symbol key.
changelog.v2.69.0: Leave a readable report behind when the client faults; Stop the report promising privacy it cannot deliver, and survive an exhausted stack.
changelog.v2.68.8: Let a row's label inherit its tone; Draw a row's label and its value as two tiers.
changelog.v2.68.7: Keep the radio's airtime trend across a restart.
changelog.v2.68.6: Give the scroll rail a gutter of its own beside a list's cards.
